segments.text: Suginami is a classmate and one of Yoshiyuki's male friends. However, you can call it a fatal friendship, as Suginami constantly pulls the protagonist to the various kind of troubles, what makes him angry. This mysterious guy is often comes up with some tricks, testing the patience of the Student Council. Suginami has an interest in paranormal phenomena and tries to investigate it. He happens to look and act almost exactly like Suginami from D.C.I.
好きなもの：『ヌー』、ロマン
嫌いなもの：秘密
クラス：風見学園付属3年3組

Her specialist magic is manifest her wish to the reality. At first time her magic invoked is when she wish to be Ichito's real little sister, but at the same time Ichito's parent and Mitsumi had an accident. Later she feel responsible for this event and reject Gen proposal to seal her memories about the cause of incident and her magic.

But right before the incident occur, she have a dream about Ichito sinking in Kagami country and then disappear after that. When she talk about it to Gen, he have a conviction that her blood as Tokisaka have been awakened and can access Tokisaka magic. Because she didn't want to lose Ichito, Gen make her to make a strong wish to grab Ichito remains existence and then pull up him from Kagami country before he disappear completely.

Her real identity is a rabbit that have been saved from death by princess from Inaba. But she receives 2 curse and a blessing after saved the princess later. Her first curse is transformation curse, when she become human she is a rabbit within it and when she become rabbit she is a human within it. The second curse is perennial youth. But her blessing make her curse become more confusing, her blessing is transformation combination. It make her become a human with rabbit ear, half human and half rabbit, nekomata rabbit type (said Reiji). After Gen update her blessing to make she can transform freely, she can hide her rabbit ear. Actually Gen can remove her curse but it only give her consecutive death after receive perennial youth.

In her route, she repeating resurrection cycle, die at the night and birth at the morning. This cycle occur when she fall in love with Ichito. At first she only feel sick but later her sick become death and then birth at the morning. This resurrection cycle will occur everyday until she meet her real death where her lifespan become empty.
